(i) <u>Comment</u>: #9
Response:
The use of census tract information to develop cross section figures for the project area was considered during the preparation of the Draft EIS, and in some cases, such as the section that deals with racial characteristics, they were taken into consideration. However, since the tracts do not overlay the project area exactly or to a degree that would lend credibility to relationships developed, such information was not used. We do believe that the cross section of the city (given in the text) is somewhat representative of the project area and that the requirements for the replacement of housing on a percentage basis is consistent with this relationship.
